title: fix: identify update snapshot failures before activation
body:
Closes #171408

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes misleading update failure headlines and retry instructions when candidate state snapshot preparation fails before activation.

## User Impact

Operators see `candidate-snapshot-failed` instead of `runtime-verification-failed` and can address the failed snapshot check. The previous Gateway continues serving; snapshot capacity admission and recovery safety remain unchanged.

## Why This Change Was Made

The canary already records snapshot-specific failure facts, but its outcome fell through to the runtime failure reason. Preserve the snapshot classification at its producer, retaining timeout precedence and the existing Doctor/runtime classifications. Move the existing capacity refusal case into the existing canary support module to stay within the test file line cap.

The same defect is present on `release/2026.10.3` (59cb44796b0f) and `release/2026.10.5` (1808b57b75f0); this PR targets main and does not publish a release or apply backports.

## Evidence

- The existing capacity-refusal regression failed on the unchanged producer: expected `candidate-snapshot-failed`, received `runtime-verification-failed`.
- Canary and report siblings: 148 tests passed; command wall time 72.84 seconds, Vitest 31.10 seconds. The extended regression took 9 ms; no new test cases or timers, effectively zero added CI test seconds.
- After extracting the capacity case, its focused replay passed (33.88 seconds including worker preparation).
- Outcome, rendered headline, and retry instruction are checked through the real canary and diagnostic consumers; no live update or operator Gateway was changed.
- Final independent P1 AutoReview: scoped clean. Focused type-aware lint, formatting, line-cap ratchet, and `git diff --check` pass.

- Core and full core-test typechecks passed. The broad changed gate completed all remaining lint, type, database, plugin, import-cycle, runtime loader, and auth/body guards.
- Broad gate exited 1 for three findings: the initial test line-cap growth was fixed by extracting the case, with the final three-file line-cap replay green; untouched main already has the unbaselined max-lines suppression in `src/commands/doctor-database-port.ts`; and Knip reports existing unused exports in `extensions/muse/src` and `ui/src/components`. Those source paths and the max-lines baseline are byte-identical to pinned main (9fb1c91d38a9). No unrelated fixes or gate bypasses are included.



Ready-for-review verification: exact head `5c0eae061eeeb59e00da552bf7ca0402990c83a7` passed [CI run 38486298161](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38486298161), with `openclaw/ci-gate`, dependency review, and security-sensitive review all successful. The earlier inherited local guard failures did not recur in hosted CI. [ClawSweeper's exact-head review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171457#issuecomment-6157664612) reports no code findings and no before-merge items, with platinum patch quality and gold proof confidence. Its optional shipped-CLI trace would raise proof confidence; the production-boundary regression remains the scoped proof for this diagnostic repair. GitHub reports non-draft, mergeable, and clean. No backports or merge were performed.

## Shared packaged update proof

The required published-driver × candidate cell passed on the configured Blacksmith Testbox: [run 38489583100](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38489583100). Published stable `2026.10.3` installed the combined frozen fixes on base `7f7fc2eddc99`: source `0471f447eb687007ee3c39fb1c9fb7e21a9c3406`, tree `4a63eeed836cc07ded69b99d3a26b0c4a01c6354`, package SHA256 `176d43d7162defd2899fd29d03e78823ac7dbb8d4bdf766feaa68237a473aeb5`. Native build carrier `98fc5321fd78` represents that same source tree. Updater exit 0; command wall time 202,913 ms and recorded update duration 172,117 ms; durable run `02efd6c3-4258-4692-8c3b-b513250cd6ab` succeeded/finished, `/readyz` returned 200, and installed build, service PID replacement, durable session preservation, and incognito erasure assertions passed. Frozen patch behavior evidence and current rebased-head CI identities are separate.

The extra installed patched-driver `missing-load-path` forward cell [failed](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38493728042): CLI exit 1 after 225 seconds, `Command cleanup could not confirm that owned work stopped`. Its cause remains unproven; the original harness removed the container before ledger/process capture. A single [diagnostic replay](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38495316771), with proof-only instrumentation tree `179c9fc91526` and the unchanged production archive, failed differently: supported debug logging polluted schema-inspection JSON, package swap failed, and the durable run finished rolled back with previous-Gateway verification exit 0. Captured PID 1 was `timeout`, with orphan zombies; that supports a reaping risk but does not establish the original error's cause. Neither forward attempt is claimed passing or fixed.

Limits: the supported published harness uses stable `2026.10.3`, not the exact incident beta; both cells use JSON output and do not exercise the CLI progress observer. They run a real Gateway with a service-manager shim; native Linux cleanup proof and observer admission-boundary regressions remain separate. No merges, backports, or release publication occurred.
